title: Energy-Based Transformers are Scalable Learners and Thinkers
transcriptExcerpt: Hello, welcome. So why are these approaches unsatisfying? And what is my argument today? So us models, or sorry, us humans are able to get to human levels intelligence without any external rewards or verifiers or supervision. So I'm going to make an argument today that if we want human level intelligence, right, so if we want artificial general intelligence or artificial super intelligence, whatever you'd like to call it, we really do need systems that learn to think on their own, on any modality problem, and without any additional supervision, just like us humans,…
